data.title: Ruzy Madencilik Publishes TSRS-Aligned 2025 Sustainability Report
data.description:
Ruzy Madencilik Ve Enerji Yatirimlari Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. ( (TR:RUZYE) ) has provided an update.

Ruzy Madencilik ve Enerji Yatırımları A.Ş. has published its 2025 sustainability report aligned with Turkey Sustainability Reporting Standards and the Public Oversight Authority’s regulations, fully matching its financial reporting boundaries. The report details Scope 1 emissions of 9,008.68 tCO2e and Scope 2 emissions of 297.97 tCO2e, while using allowed exemptions to omit comparative data and Scope 3 emissions.

The company outlines climate-related physical risks for its open-pit operations and uses IEA and IPCC-based scenario analyses to test strategic resilience under transition and high physical risk pathways. It highlights operational changes, such as replacing 20 old trucks with 10 newer units and preparing a private capital increase to fund renewable energy investments, and links 20% of senior management bonuses to climate and energy targets, underscoring a growing integration of sustainability into governance and capital allocation.

data.title: Inflation Expectations Edge Higher, Stirring Fed Policy Jitters
data.description:
U.S. Michigan 5 Year Inflation Expectations ticked up to 3.4% from 3.3%, a 0.1 percentage point increase. That marks a roughly 3% rise from the prior reading, signaling slightly higher long-term inflation perceptions among consumers.

The actual figure of 3.4% topped the analyst estimate of 3.2%, reinforcing concerns that inflation expectations remain elevated and sticky. This development pressures rate-sensitive sectors such as growth and tech stocks, while supporting value and financial shares as markets reassess the Federal Reserve’s policy path with a bias toward prolonged tight conditions.

data.title: Surging Michigan Inflation Expectations Jolt Rate-Cut Hopes
data.description:
U.S. Michigan Inflation Expectations jumped to 4.6% from 4.0%, a 0.6 percentage point increase and roughly a 15% rise versus the prior reading. The move marks a clear acceleration in consumer inflation views after the previous month’s more moderate level.

The 4.6% reading sharply overshot the analyst estimate of 3.9%, signaling stickier inflation expectations that are likely to pressure rate-cut hopes. Growth and tech stocks may face renewed valuation headwinds, while financials, particularly banks, may benefit from a perception of prolonged higher-rate conditions. The impact leans toward a medium-term shift in policy expectations rather than a purely short-term sentiment move.

data.title: Anvi Global Holdings Approves One-for-Twenty Reverse Split
data.description:
An update from Anvi Global Holdings ( (ANVI) ) is now available.

On September 4, 2026, the majority holder of ANVI Global Holdings, Inc.’s common stock, representing about 60% of the voting capital, executed a written consent approving a one‑for‑twenty reverse stock split of the company’s issued and outstanding shares. The board had recommended this move on August 29, 2026, and under Nevada law the majority stockholder’s consent was sufficient to authorize the action without a physical meeting or vote of minority shareholders.

The reverse stock split is aimed at lifting ANVI’s share price after a June 6, 2026 deficiency notice from OTC Markets Group, which warned that the company’s bid price had stayed below $0.01 for 30 days and threatened its OTCQB listing. Implementation of the split remains contingent on SEC Schedule 14C clearance and FINRA approval, and the company is concurrently requesting a 60‑day extension to meet listing criteria after delays and geopolitical disruptions derailed a planned asset injection strategy to support compliance.

data.title: Tandem’s Takeover of Compagnia dei Caraibi Clears 90% Threshold, Delisting Looms
data.description:
An announcement from Compagnia dei Caraibi S.p.A. ( (IT:TIME) ) is now available.

Tandem S.r.l.’s voluntary takeover bid for Compagnia dei Caraibi has closed with acceptances of 2,125,894 shares, equal to 56.507% of the shares subject to the offer and 14.683% of the issuer’s share capital. Together with shares acquired outside the offer and those already held by Gem S.r.l. and Trolley S.r.l., plus treasury stock, Tandem and concert parties are set to control 91.964% of the company.

This level of ownership exceeds the 90% threshold required to trigger squeeze-out procedures and pave the way for the delisting of Compagnia dei Caraibi from the market. As a result, there will be no reopening of the offer terms, and the purchase right and related purchase obligation will apply to the remaining 8.036% of the share capital, marking a shift toward full control by the offeror and reduced liquidity for minority shareholders.

data.title: HNO International Raises Capital via Dilutive Convertible Note
data.description:
HNO International ( (HNOI) ) has shared an update.

On September 4, 2026, HNO International, Inc. entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement with CFI Capital LLC, issuing a convertible redeemable note with a principal amount of $210,000, including a $21,000 original issue discount for a net purchase price of $189,000. The note matures on September 4, 2027, carries 6% annual interest, and may be converted into common stock starting six months after issuance at a substantial discount to prevailing market prices, subject to a beneficial ownership cap and extensive share reservation commitments.

The financing terms, including deep conversion discounts, a most-favored-nation clause, and requirements to reserve multiples of the shares needed for full conversion, underscore that HNO International is relying on highly dilutive convertible debt to raise capital. These features may significantly affect existing shareholders through potential dilution while providing the company with near-term funding flexibility and positioning CFI Capital as a key financial stakeholder in its capital structure.

data.title: Green Zebras SA Calls Extraordinary Meeting to Seek Flexible Capital Increase Powers
data.description:
Green Zebras SA ( (PL:GRZ) ) has shared an update.

Green Zebras SA has called an Extraordinary General Meeting for 9 October 2026 in Wrocław, signaling a key moment in its ongoing management of capital structure and shareholder governance. The meeting will be held at a notary office in the Sky Tower building, reflecting the formal nature of the proceedings under Polish corporate law.

The central items on the agenda concern amending the company’s Articles of Association to authorize the Management Board to increase share capital within the framework of authorized capital. Crucially, this authorization would allow the Board, with Supervisory Board consent, to exclude existing shareholders’ pre-emptive rights for new shares, a move that could facilitate faster capital raising but potentially dilute current holdings.
